prior_reason_rebuttal: Prior verdict said 'Website returned no usable content (empty/placeholder)'. medspabroomfield.com now 301-redirects to thenaturalplacemedspa.com, which is a fully-built, real medspa site (address, phone, booking, service categories Injectables/Laser & Skin/Facials & Body/Wellness/Body Sculpting, named injectables XEOMIN/Daxxify/Belotero Balance/Radiesse). The old 'no usable content' read was an artifact of the site being a pure client-side React SPA (confirmed via curl: raw HTML is just a JS bundle with no server-rendered text) — scrape-digest.ts's cheerio-based fetch legitimately sees empty TEXT on every path (see pass1.txt), but a JS-executing browser fetch (pass2-browser.txt) shows a normal, complete medspa site underneath. This is not a placeholder/dead site; it was mis-triaged because the tooling couldn't render JS.
